execution_scope: one local bare Git repository, independent editor and contributor clones, and a fresh recovery clone on the same host
excluded_claims: Two real GitHub accounts or real GitHub permission enforcement
Live Tencent Docs or WeChat operations
Encryption or protection against an authorized repository reader
Real author approval or literary quality

cases.expected: The contributor clone restores the synthetic accepted baseline and matching registered content hashes.
The contributor can submit a candidate and review. Only the editor registers the integrated result after an explicitly synthetic decision fixture.
A package bound to an older official baseline is rejected after the baseline changes, without updating the official registry or lifecycle.
Changing a package member after packaging is rejected, without updating the official registry or lifecycle.

A contributor branch containing local lifecycle or official-registry changes is rejected by the collaboration guard. Existing writing commands may still create those local changes; they must not be accepted into the editor's official chain.
A fresh clone restores the accepted version identity, ancestry, content hashes, and valid sequential lifecycle.
